images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Landscape 16:9 side-cutaway screenshot of an underwater stealth game set in a flooded museum tank. The water surface is a bright rippling line across the upper quarter; above it a dim museum gallery with lit display cases seen wobbly through refraction, and two guard silhouettes patrolling. Each guard casts a long dark shadow column straight down into the turquoise water, with small tags showing their patrol direction. Between the shadows, sunlit god rays and dancing caustic light patterns fall onto swaying kelp and dark rocks. A sleek diver in a dark wetsuit, rim-lit cyan, swims holding a glowing gold treasure chest, a soft gold halo around it, a dotted cyan route leading to an exit hatch on the seabed. HUD: title top-left, a stage chip, artifact slots top-right, a green pill status in the centre, an oxygen and carried-weight panel bottom-left and a controls panel bottom-right. Korean UI: "수면 아래 스텔스", "움직여도 된다", "산소". Clean stylized realism, teal to navy gradient, cyan and gold accents.

images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Landscape 16:9 side-cutaway screenshot of the tense freeze moment in an underwater stealth game. Above the rippling surface a guard silhouette has stopped and aims a flashlight down; his shadow column hangs motionless in the water while a hard cone of pale light slices diagonally through the turquoise water and sweeps close to the seabed. The diver, outlined in warning red, lies pressed flat against a dark rock clutching a gold chest, just outside the beam; a thin chain of escaping air bubbles rises toward the surface, with a pulsing red ring where they would break it. Red alarm vignette pulses around the edges. A huge glowing word in the centre commands the player to freeze, with a small subtitle. HUD: red detection bar bottom-centre at 78 percent, oxygen and breath-hold bars bottom-left, instruction panel bottom-right. Korean UI: "멈춰", "발각 78%", "숨 참기". Cinematic stylized realism, teal water flooded with crimson alarm and a white flashlight beam. Consistency and mechanic: this is the same flooded museum tank as before — above the waterline a dim museum gallery with lit display cases, no harbor, pier or shipwreck. The stopped guard's long dark shadow column falls straight down through the water from where he stands and is clearly visible, frozen in place, next to the flashlight cone.
